title: Doubled Rooks Decide
setup: Your rooks are doubled on the seventh rank, and a black rook sits on the f-file behind its own king.
hint: Two rooks on one rank means one of them can step forward while the other keeps it defended. Which file matters?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rgf7+}} puts a rook on the f-file with the king in front and the rook on **f3** behind. The rook on **e7** defends f7, so the king cannot capture. After {{Kg5}} the file is clear and {{Rxf3}} wins the rook.
